name: @aloud/app
description: Aloud — accessible cross-platform read-aloud reader (RN/TypeScript layer), consumed as a library by example/.
//: react/react-native/react-native-webview/async-storage are peer deps of this package; the unit-tested modules (ViewModel, ReadingPreferences, a11y policy, contract, trace) intentionally do NOT import them, so `npm test`/`npm run typecheck` run in plain Node. example/ supplies the real peers and is where the RN-dependent modules (ReaderScreen, the native adapter) actually get type-checked and run.
